text:
maya: heads-up: starting bring-up for q4b-lite quantized build. doing a small curation run to validate promptset stability + golden coverage before full canary.

omar: nice — can you paste the baseline metrics we care about? latency/cost/quality thresholds?

lena: baseline from prod (fp16) -> latency p95 180ms, cost/token $0.0021, toxic-f1 0.89, helpfulness @ 0.78 (eval harness).

maya: target: cost/token <= $0.0013 (expect ~40% saving), p95 <= 230ms (okay to degrade up to 25%), toxic-f1 drop <= 0.02 absolute, helpfulness drop <= 0.03 absolute.

nate: plan for curation: 1) small sample (5k prompts) prioritized by high-risk intents + recent golden anchors; 2) dedupe + multi-model fingerprint check; 3) run annotator queue for a limited gold relabel.

sam: timeline? i can block labeler capacity Thurs-Fri if we scope to 5k. labeler-bot: queued 5k golden tasks -> expected throughput 1.2k/day (3 annotators).

maya: thanks. dedupe rules: fingerprint-hash v3, allow near-duplicates if edit distance > 15%, exclude paraphrase-only near matches. also add longctx partition for prompts > 1024 tokens.

omar: for quant config i'm going to try grouped-4bit gcq with group_size 128. config snippet:
```
quant_config: {"type": "gqa", "bits": 4, "group_size": 128, "fallback": "int8"}
```

lena: can we add a secondary run with group_size 64? curious about quality tradeoffs for longctx.

maya: yes — run both gs=128 and gs=64 for the 1k longctx subset. include kernel_profile logging. ops-bot: canary VM pool created: pool-id=canary-q4b-lite-2026-03-10.

nate: evaluation hooks: run eval-harness v2.4 against golden promptset + targeted safety suite. please export diffs and per-prompt deltas. also capture kvcache reuse stats.

sam: labeler-bot: added annotation rubric for "helpful" vs "concise"; golden relabel will use 3 annotator majority + adjudication.

maya: risk mitigation: if toxic-f1 drops > 0.02, auto-fallback to fp16 for those routes. config:
```
route_policy: {"model": ["q4b-lite","fp16-fallback"], "trigger": {"metric":"toxic-f1","delta": 0.02}}
```

omar: quick note: quantized run shows tokenization edgecases — emojis and unicode combining chars push effective ctx up. make sure tokenizer v2 used.

lena: i'll add a sampler that over-weights emoji and long numeric sequences for the 500 sample stress-check.

ops-bot: canary deploy success (3/3 nodes ready). readout link: https://console/internal/canaries/canary-q4b-lite-2026-03-10

maya: running first pass now. will post lightweight CSV of per-prompt metric deltas when done.

(30m later)

maya: first-pass results: overall cost/token -42%, p95 +18% (within target), toxic-f1 -0.025 (slightly above threshold), helpfulness -0.015. attaching top 12 regressions in comments.

nate: thanks — which buckets show the toxic drop? specific intents?

maya: majority in "policy paraphrase" and "instruction-following ambiguity" buckets. examples: prompts that previously triggered safe-formatting now undergenerate.

lena: hypothesis: quantization squeezes logits for safety tokens in long prefixes. suggest targeted prefix-aware recalibration or preserve-fp for safety head.

omar: quick test: re-run with mixed-precision for final layers (last 2 transformer blocks fp16). small config tweak:
```
quant_config: {"mixed_fp_layers": 2}
```

sam: i can requeue the 1k affected prompts for relabel after the mixed-fp run. labeler-bot: relabel batch ready -> ETA 18 hours.

maya: decision: pause rollout, run mixed-fp (last-2) experiment on longctx subset + rerun safety eval. if toxic-f1 recovers to within 0.02, proceed to expanded 20k curation pass.

ops-bot: experiment run scheduled. job-id=exp-7171. logs: https://logs/internal/exp-7171

(2h later)

omar: mixed-fp run result: toxic-f1 delta now -0.011 vs fp16, helpfulness delta -0.012, p95 +19%. looks good.

maya: great. next actions: 1) expand sampling to 20k with dedupe tolerance relaxed to 12% for paraphrase grouping; 2) update golden: add 1.2k new golden anchors from confirmed relabels; 3) create canary rollout plan for 10% traffic on low-risk routes.

nate: i'll create JIRA ML-824 to track the 20k curation sweep and rollout tasks.

lena: reminder: coordinate with eng-oncall for the canary window (we need SLO override + rollback playbook ready).

sam: will reserve labeler capacity Wed-Fri for the 20k job. labeler-bot: reserved 5 annotators, expected throughput 6k/day.

maya: thanks everyone. final note: keep a snapshot of promptset+model fingerprints for drift analysis (store in s3://prod-curation-snapshots/q4b-lite/2026-03-10).

labeler-bot: snapshot created -> s3://prod-curation-snapshots/q4b-lite/2026-03-10/snapshot.tar.gz :thumbsup:

omar: i'm going to write up a short postmortem-like note in the doc with the mixed-fp fix so others can reuse. :memo:

maya: perfect. closing for now, will ping when the 20k run finishes. :rocket:
